highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded in 1909, ESSCA is a respected, top-ranked management school in Europe. It is a member of the Conférence des Grandes Écoles and a holder of the Triple Crown Accreditation  (from AACSB, EQUIS, and AMBA). In fact, it’s among the top 1% of business schools worldwide and is recognised globally for its academic excellence.

ESSCA has around 7000 students in undergraduate, postgraduate and executive education programs, and over 500 professors and administrative support staff.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
You’ll be part of a vibrant and friendly student population, with ESSCA’s Student Union handling all active clubs and societies on campus. The Student Union includes the Bachelor Student Office, The Grande École program students’ office, the Student Sports Council, and more.

You can choose to join from over 70 student clubs and societies across all ESSCA campuses, choose between individual and team sports, and participate in over 190 events hosted each year.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
You can easily find many accommodation options close to ESSCA's campuses, ranging from residence halls and shared flats, to private homes. ESSCA partners with Studapart to provide you with rental options close to the campuses, all across France.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Sports
ESSCA’s Student Sports Council (BDS) comprises various sports clubs and teams. You’ll have 77 individual and team sports to choose from and numerous events to participate in.

Laboratory
The Research Labs at ESSCA offer you a great opportunity to be part of ongoing research at the campus. The University’s Behavioral and Experimental Lab is a cutting-edge facility with physiological measurement equipment and a mobile unit setup for real-world experiments.

The University's Data Lab specialises in Artificial Intelligence and provides equipment and expertise to help businesses. It is an exchange centre for researchers, scientists, and industry professionals.
